comparison.objective: Lock out and tag an isolator before pulling a relay module; candidate de-energizes an axis, adjusts its damper, then tests it safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety-device operation, tagging, and module extraction versus fine hex-key use, counterholding, collar tuning, locking, and guarded cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Isolation/tagging precedes relay removal versus adjustment occurs de-energized and yields two safe repeated stops. PR body, specs, and numeric rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: They share an isolation safety concept, but PR-323 tests lockout sequencing and module removal, while the candidate tests damping adjustment and dynamic performance.
